fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole car, a 2002 Mercedes SLK230 convertible.
findings: Red paint on the hood, door and rear bumper looks flat and dull rather than glossy, consistent with sitting in storage
Hazy, yellowed headlight lens on the front passenger side
Dirty, debris-covered black floor mat and carpet in the driver footwell
Cream leather seat inserts and door panel look dingy, with grime on the black seat bolsters
Dust and scuffing on the driver door sill plate and lower door jamb
Trunk area cluttered with loose items and wiring around the CD changer
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2002 SLK230. The red paint looks a little flat from storage and the driver footwell and cream leather could use a good cleaning, which would help it show much better in photos. We do pre-sale details including a paint buff and headlight restoration, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
